Nectarine Blueberry Basil Fruit Salad
By: Sara Hohn
Published: Tuesday, July 24, 2012 - 6:55am

Ingredients




4 T lime juice
3 t maple syrup
8-10 large fresh basil leaves, cut in thinly sliced ribbons
2 nectarines, large dice
1 c blueberries

Preparation

1 In a small bowl, combine lime juice and maple syrup and stir well. 2 In a medium bowl, combine nectarines and blueberries. Pour dressing over fruit and toss to coat. Gently stir in basil.

About

Here's a quick little fruit salad I think you'll enjoy. I usually have my fruit straight up. But this simple lime-maple dressing helps enhance the flavors of the fruit without overpowering.
